tagline: Scene view, a second screen for GMs and players, and a redesigned player view.

entries.headline: Run the whole session from a single Scene tab, show it on a second screen for the GM and players alike, and give players a view that shows what they need to do.

sections.title: Scene view
items: The Scene tab replaces Field, Group and Turns: players and field in compact rows, with the selected actor's details on the right.
The session bar gathers the lobby, online players, ambiance, access requests, dice, announcements and a single main action: start combat, end the current turn, move to the next turn.
HP can be adjusted from the row (Shift for 5), and the die offers the actor's stats.
A marker, a saved NPC or a pinned monster can be added in one click.
In combat, the turn order brings players and field together. In a narrow window, the columns become tabs.

sections.title: Second screen
items: In a lobby, the GM and co-GMs can show the scene in their web browser (Google Chrome, Firefox, etc.) and keep the game on the main screen.
From the GM page: end a turn, mark who has acted, adjust HP, MP and shield, accept or decline a subgroup, request a roll, roll for a marker or an NPC, make an announcement.

Players too: "Open on a second screen", in the player view's "..." menu, shows My sheet, the scene and the turn order in the web browser, with the same actions as in game (roll a stat, answer the GM, end your turn).
Players' UmbraSync avatars appear on both pages.
Each link works only once, and the page only opens on the computer running the game.

sections.title: Player view
items: Redesigned after the Scene view: a session bar, Scene and My sheet, and a single highlighted action, only when the player is expected to act.
When the GM requests a roll, "Roll Dexterity" is all it takes; during your turn, "End my turn".
My sheet keeps your stats in view: clicking a stat rolls the die, and a search bar filters them ("dex" finds Dexterity and its skills).
Teammates, NPCs, ambiance and the GM's latest announcement stay visible.
Any member of an initiative group can end the group's turn.

sections.title: Lobby and group
items: Another character on the same account no longer goes back into the previous character's lobby, and a GM's alt no longer takes over their lobby.
Relogging, or restarting after a crash, always brings you back to the lobby.
Leaving the group during a loading screen or an instance is now taken into account on arrival.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Nothing from MasterEvent shows on the title screen anymore: the release notes and the setup assistant wait until your character is in the game, and open windows hide after logging out.
Players' UmbraSync avatars now show up reliably, even when UmbraSync connects after MasterEvent, and in every player row: Scene view, player view, turn order.
The GM's weather and time no longer follow a player after leaving the group or lobby, or onto another character.
A brief network drop no longer reprints the turn order or makes the weather jump.
Double-clicking a stat no longer rolls twice.
Stat searches now ignore accents.
